text:
return
Description
Causes immediate exit from the currently executing event in the
currently executing iRule. iRule processing is not aborted, and
subsequent events will be triggered and evaluated.
Note that
return
does
not
:
cause an exit from the iRule altogether;
prevent the same event from firing in another iRule; or
prevent the same event with a higher priority value from firing in
the same iRule.
To prevent further processing of an event in the current rule or other
rules for the current TCP connection, you can use
‘
event
EVENT_NAME disable’.
Syntax
return
return
exits from the currently executing event in the currently executing
iRule
Examples
when
CLIENT_LINE
{
if{
[
TCP
::
payload
]
contains
$srch
}
{
return
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
GLOBAL_GTM
